units.source_text: 众女子如此抗声争辩，终于不能决定两画卷孰优孰劣。

en.t: The women argued so loudly and fiercely that in the end they could not decide which of the two picture scrolls was better.

units.source_text: 学识较浅的青年宫女，拼命想知道这比赛的结果。

en.t: The younger ladies-in-waiting with less learning were desperate to know the outcome of the contest.

units.source_text: 然而此事非常秘密，皇上的宫女与母后的宫女都一点也不让看。

en.t: Yet the matter was kept highly secret, and neither the Emperor's attendants nor the Empress Mother's attendants would let anyone see even the slightest part of it.

units.source_text: 正在此时，源氏内大臣进宫来了。

en.t: Just then, Genji, the Inner Minister, came to the palace.

units.source_text: 他看她们争论得如此热烈，颇感兴趣，便说道：“既然要争论，就在陛下御前决定胜负吧。”

en.t: Seeing how passionately they were arguing, he became quite interested and said, "If you are going to debate it, let the winner be decided before His Majesty."

units.source_text: 他预料到将有大规模比赛，因此特别优越的作品，起初不拿出来。

en.t: He had expected that there would be a large-scale contest, so at first he did not bring out his especially superior works.

units.source_text: 现在计上心来，便将须磨、明石二卷加入其中，一并取出来了。

en.t: Now that a plan had come to him, he added the two scrolls of Suma and Akashi to the others and brought them all out together.

units.source_text: 权中纳言的用心不让于源氏内大臣。

en.t: The Acting Middle Counselor's careful preparations were no less thorough than Genji the Inner Minister's.

units.source_text: 因此在这时代，举世之人都热衷于此，以制作美妙画幅为急务了。

en.t: Thus in that age, people everywhere became absorbed in this pursuit and treated the making of splendid pictures as an urgent matter.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣声言道：“特地新作的，无甚意味；此次赛画，当以旧藏者为限。”

en.t: Genji the Inner Minister declared openly, "Works newly made for the occasion have little meaning; this picture contest should be limited to pieces that have long been kept in one's collection."

units.source_text: 原来权中纳言特设一密室，教人在内作画，不令人见。

en.t: It turned out that the Acting Middle Counselor had specially prepared a secret room, had people paint inside it, and allowed no one else to see the work.

units.source_text: 朱雀院也闻知此事，便将所藏佳作送与梅壶女御。

en.t: Suzaku-in also heard of this and sent the fine works in his collection to the Umetsubo Consort.
